Read this passage aloud

Sam's shy cat chased five zebras through the big village near our yellow farm. The cook quickly washed both dishes with her rough gloves and sang a joyful song. Peter picked peppers while his twin brother measured the long wooden fence. Don't zip your jacket near the sharp rocks or you might get hurt. Vivid vines hung low over the narrow path that leads to the misty lake. She sells azure treasure at leisure, measuring the beige genre with pleasure. The judge charged George with using rouge on the beige vision. Whether the weather is warm or whether it's not, we will gather feathers together. The phone rang through the thick fog as young boys played rough games on the bridge. Quick wax jobs vex daft quiz kids. Zinc mixed with oxygen forms a curious molecule. Hugh knew the new gnu flew through the blue dew.

~120 syllables  ·  ~55–75 seconds fluent  ·  covers all 40 phonemes

SSI-4 measures

Tabla sound

Using synthesised tabla.
The app synthesises the tabla by default. Real recordings sound far better, but sample libraries are licensed per user, so the files have to come from you. Load one single stroke per sound below — not a loop.
Where to get them — free
Pixabay is the easiest. Royalty-free, no attribution, no account needed to browse. Search the tag tabla-stroke — 114 results, and many are genuine single hits from an academic tabla dataset rather than loops.
pixabay.com/sound-effects/search/tabla-stroke/

Useful ones on that page: Da_Test01–11 are Dha strokes (Da_Test11 is tagged din, so use it for Dhin), and ghe_6 is a Ge.

freesound.org also works — search “tabla dha”, “tabla na”.
Record your own is best of all: six taps on a real tabla, matched to your own tuning.
Only found loops? Slice one
Most free tabla audio is loops rather than single strokes. Load one here and the app will find the individual hits inside it. Play each one, decide which stroke it is, and assign it.
